name: Topology UI Toolkit
description: Project-local ability configuration for building a resizable, node-based network topology editor.

packages.name: @xyflow/react
useFor: selection, controls, minimap, and connection editing

packages.name: elkjs
useFor: supporting left-to-right and top-to-bottom network diagrams

packages.name: react-resizable-panels
useFor: resizing the device list, topology canvas, and inspector

stateMapping.Group: parent node or visual group metadata

commands.verify: npm run lint && npm run build
